title: Willowmere After Hours
desc: Night-shift horror at an animal hospital. Keep the patients calm. Keep the doors ready. Survive until 6 AM.

updates.title: Achievements
notes: Achievements: unlock them as you play (a 🏆 pops up), and see them all on the Game Library's new Profile page.
Your progress syncs between devices too (☁ Sync).

updates.title: Overtime
notes: New: Night 6 · Overtime, unlocked once you finish night 5. A new patient, Ziggy the ferret, lives in a pen in the lobby (camera 4).
Ziggy doesn't use the halls. If he turns, he's in the walls: listen for his chitter on the left, the right or the vent, and shut that one fast.
The generator surges on Overtime: every door pops open and the cameras reboot.
Nights: replay any night you've reached and earn up to 3 stars (survive · keep 25% power · nobody turns).
Custom Night challenges (Pack Animals, Birdwatching, Runners, Skeleton Crew), ticked off when you beat them. Ziggy can join Custom Night too.
Patient files: every patient's chart, how many times they got you, and how many correct doses you've given them.
Sync: keep your progress on all your devices (☁ SYNC on the menu).

updates.title: Controllers and phones
notes: Play with a controller: the left stick looks around, the bumpers shut the doors, the triggers work the lights, and A raises the cameras. Menus work with the D-pad.
Play on a phone: drag to look around, tap the buttons along the bottom for the doors, lights and vent, and tap the phone box to answer calls.
More settings: screen shake and flashes (full, reduced or off), auto resolution, fullscreen and controllers. Settings can now be opened from the pause menu.

updates.title: Install as an app
notes: Willowmere After Hours can be installed as an app from the menu (INSTALL AS APP), with its own icon. It opens fullscreen and works offline once it has loaded.

updates.title: Release
notes: Night-shift horror at Willowmere animal hospital: five nights, plus a Custom Night.
Keep Biscuit, Mittens, Hoppy and Pepper calm on the cameras: feed them, play them music, or dose them at the medication station.
Let a patient's stress reach 100 and it turns, and comes for you.
From night 4, the Stray only moves when nobody is watching it.

title: Bonk Bowl
desc: 3-player party game on one keyboard. Dash into your friends and bonk them off a crumbling hex arena. Last blob standing wins.

updates.title: Carousel, Factory Floor, magnets and bananas
notes: New arena: Carousel. The whole bowl turns and carries you with it.
New arena: Factory Floor. Conveyor belts push you sideways: ride them into a bonk, or fight them.
New power-ups: MAGNET pulls everyone toward you, BANANA drops a peel that sends whoever steps on it spinning.
Achievements: unlock them as you play (a 🏆 pops up), and see them all on the Game Library's new Profile page.

updates.title: Online
notes: Play online: press 🌐 Online in the lobby. One of you hosts and shares the 4-letter code (or the link); friends join from their own computers.
Friends take the free slots; the host can still add CPUs and local players on the same keyboard.
If a friend drops out mid-match, a CPU takes over their blob.
Settings: volume, screen shake, auto resolution and fullscreen. Big bonks freeze for a split second and the winning knock-off plays in slow motion.

updates.title: Install as an app
notes: Bonk Bowl can be installed as an app from the lobby (Install as an app), with its own icon. It opens fullscreen and works offline once it has loaded.

updates.title: New maps, and easier to play
notes: Four new maps: Donut Dunes, Three Isles, Bumper Park and Frozen Pond, plus Random each round.
Snappier movement with less sliding, softer knockback and a quicker dash recharge.
A small edge lip: you wobble on the edge before you fall.
The floor starts crumbling later and slower.
CPU difficulty: Easy, Normal or Hard (Easy by default).

updates.title: Release
notes: Three blobs, one keyboard, one crumbling bowl: dash into your friends and knock them off.
CPU players fill any empty seats.
Pickups: MEGA, ZOOM and QUAKE.
First to 3, 5 or 7 rounds wins.

title: BREACH: ZERO
desc: A dark first-person horror shooter. You are trapped five floors under Ardent Biolabs after a containment breach. Find keycards, outrun the Stalker, kill THE HOST, and get to the surface lift.

updates.title: The incinerator and the Burster
notes: New weapon: the INCINERATOR [5]. Hold the trigger for a cone of fire that sets things alight. Find it on Sublevel 3; fuel cans refill it. You start Survival with it.
New enemy: the BURSTER, a swollen husk that waddles up and bursts in acid. Shoot it early, or pop it next to its friends: the blast hurts them too. From Sublevel 3, and in Survival from wave 3.
Achievements: unlock them as you play (a 🏆 pops up), and see them all on the Game Library's new Profile page.

updates.title: Five floors down
notes: Two new floors before the reactor: the flooded Pump Station and the overrun Security Wing.
The Stalker: something tall, pale and unkillable hunts you in set scenes on floors 2 to 4. Run.
THE HOST: pull the reactor breaker and the lab's nest wakes up. Kill it to call the freight lift.
New weapons: an SMG, and a crowbar that's always with you (quiet, no ammo, quick bash on V / RB).
Scripted scares: dying lights, a runner in the dark, a body that wasn't there, footsteps, a door slammed shut.
Survival mode: endless waves in the Containment Hall, with THE HOST every fifth wave.
Records screen and four unlockable extras: VHS filter, noir filter, infinite flashlight, golden guns.
Controller support (wheels and joysticks are ignored so the view never spins on its own).
Menus remade as a CRT security terminal; the HUD is now a wrist bio-monitor with a live heartbeat.

updates.title: Performance update
notes: Far fewer draw calls: monsters, walls, decals and guns are batched together.
Cheaper glow and post-processing, one less light on every pixel, and a pixel cap for big screens.
New Auto resolution setting lowers the render resolution when the frame rate drops.
Shaders are prepared when a floor loads, so new monsters no longer cause a hitch.

updates.title: Release
notes: Three floors under Ardent Biolabs, four monster types, pistol and shotgun, nine audio logs and the reactor finale.

title: Mochi's Happy Meadow
desc: A super cute little bunny platformer! Collect carrots with your friends in the sunny meadow ♥

updates.title: Achievements
notes: Achievements: unlock them as you play (a 🏆 pops up), and see them all on the Game Library's new Profile page.
Your progress syncs between devices too (☁ Sync).

updates.title: Install as an app
notes: Mochi's Happy Meadow can be installed as an app from the title screen (Install app ♥), with its own bunny icon. It opens fullscreen and works offline once it has loaded.

updates.title: Realistic 3D garden
notes: The garden is far more realistic: flashlight shadows, a light beam through dust and mist, film grain and motion blur.
Dead twisted trees, tens of thousands of grass blades moving in the wind, and much worse flowers.
Sunny is new: hunched, starved, in a torn costume and a cracked porcelain mask.
Heavier movement: head-bob, stumbles and breath fog.
A Graphics setting (Auto, High, Low).

updates.title: Scarier, and on phones
notes: Sunny's footsteps move around you, and Sunny speaks.
Panic breathing, a lights-out scare, fake footsteps behind you, and a red garden in the final chase.
Phone controls: buttons in the 2D part, and a joystick, drag-to-look and action buttons in 3D.

updates.title: Release
notes: A super cute bunny platformer. Collect carrots in the sunny meadow. Day 1, Day 2, Day 3...
Something is wrong with the meadow.

title: Hollow Badge
desc: A dark first-person detective game in your browser. Four cases, one collector. Free, no download. Contains disturbing themes.

updates.title: Sync and achievements
notes: Sync: keep your case results and lilies on all your devices. Press ☁ Sync on the menu, then enter the code on your other device. No account or email.
Achievements: close each case, solve one on hard, find all three white lilies. A 🏆 pops up when you get one, and the Game Library's Profile page shows them all.

updates.title: Download for PC
notes: A Download for PC button on the menu: it opens the Game Library page, where one click installs the library as a PC app with Hollow Badge and all the other games in one place. It is hidden on phones.

updates.title: Install as an app
notes: Hollow Badge can be installed as an app: press Install as app on the menu (Chrome / Edge / Android), or Share > Add to Home Screen on iPhone. It gets its own icon, opens fullscreen and works offline once it has loaded.

updates.title: Clean-up
notes: Phones: the ending screen scrolls, so Go home and Epilogue can no longer end up off the bottom of a landscape phone.
Phones: presenting evidence in an interview scrolls the clue list into view, and the LIGHT and NOTES buttons now tick off the how-to-play checklist.
The menu buttons no longer overlap the tagline.
The epilogue morning looks like morning: the rain on your window has stopped.
The unused voice-acting system has been removed. The game stays fully subtitled.
Links to the game now show a proper preview image, and the browser tab has a badge icon.
Behind the scenes: tidier code, a saved suite of automated playtests (desktop and phone), and a licence.

updates.title: Fully subtitled
notes: Hollow Badge is fully subtitled with no spoken dialogue. The voice-actor recording link has been removed from the menu.

updates.title: The Final Cut
notes: A living title screen: the menu drifts down a rainy Ashgrove street at night.
An epilogue after the finale, and a credits roll.
A white lily is hidden somewhere off the path in Cases 01, 02 and 03. Find all three for the true ending.
Reduce flashing (on the content warning and in settings): calms lightning, jumpscare flashes, police lights, flickering lamps and screen shake.
New settings: subtitle size, field of view, invert look, controllers on/off. A short how-to-play checklist the first time you play.
Gamepad support: left stick to move, right stick to look, A to examine, X flashlight, Y notebook, LT to hold your breath, Start to pause, and the D-pad works every menu.

updates.title: Fix: home objectives
notes: The apartment now follows what you have done: messages, mail, then the case wall. With Cases 01 to 03 finished, the payphone downstairs rings and the door takes you straight into Case 04.

updates.title: Fix: your car in Case 04
notes: Your car in Ashgrove is now parked outside your building with its headlights on, and walking up to it opens the case board (it used to do nothing).

title: LIFE WILL END: NOW RUN
desc: A first-person parkour shooter in a drowned neon city. Run the walls, cut the bullets, climb the Spire before dawn.

updates.title: Voices, surround sound and new models
notes: Voices: Wren, HALCYON and the courier now speak their radio lines out loud (your system's text to speech), each with their own voice. The ending is read out too. Turn it off or set its volume in Settings.
Surround sound: enemy shots, their charge-up before firing, bullets whizzing past, charger footsteps, impacts and kills come from where they happen. Best on headphones; switch it off in Settings.

Every model rebuilt: armoured wardens with helmets, visors and shoulder plates, a hooded long-rifle sniper, a riot-shield warden, a hunched blade-armed charger, rotor drones, twin-barrel turrets, crystal pylons and a new HALCYON core with an iris.
The wardens move now: they aim at you, recoil when they fire, breathe while they wait and run on two legs.
Your gun, blade and gloved hands rebuilt, with a glowing edge that flares when you cut.

updates.title: Every controller, and phones
notes: Controllers: Xbox, PlayStation (DualShock 4 and DualSense), Steam Deck and the Steam Controller all work, in Chrome, Edge and Firefox, with or without Steam running.
Button names follow the pad you are holding: A / B / LB / RT on Xbox, ✕ / ○ / L1 / R2 on PlayStation, L1 / R2 on Steam Deck. Wren's tips use them too.
Vibration on pads that support it, a little aim help on sticks, and menus you can drive with the D-pad.
Phones and tablets: a thumb stick, drag to look, and buttons for jump, slide, dash, fire, blade and focus. Play it sideways.
Settings: controller vibration on or off, touch look speed.

updates.title: Release
notes: A new game: a first-person parkour shooter in a drowned neon megacity. HALCYON is opening the sea gates at dawn. Climb the Spire and stop it.
Run the walls, slide under pipes, dash and double-jump. One hit kills you, and one hit kills them, but you're straight back at the last checkpoint.
A gun with six shots and a blade that cuts wardens down and sends their bullets back at them. Hold Q to slow time.
Six chapters with a story over the radio, a boss at the top of the Spire, times and ranks for every chapter.
Controller support, settings, achievements and ☁ Sync between your devices.

title: Mimic
desc: A free first-person horror game in your browser. It records your voice and uses it to lure you, and your friends, into the dark.

updates.title: It listens first
notes: The mimic sorts what it hears (screams, calls, help, laughs, whispers) and uses the right one at the right moment.
It calls from the dark near what you're looking for, sounds like the friend you split from, and answers when you shout for someone.
Each night it starts by listening, then copies, then hunts.
Learn its tells: a wet click in its throat before it speaks, and your flashlight dips twice when it's close.

updates.title: Nearly finished
notes: Mimic is in beta: fourteen places, three stories and every mode, so now it's fixing and polishing.
New places: a lighthouse island, the sewers, a liner in a storm, a snow research station and an old mine.
A third story, The Babysitter, in five chapters.
Endless descent: floor after floor, each worse than the last.
The patient, the rat swarm, and a new mode, Imposter voices.
It walks like you, and its copies of your voice get better as the night goes on.
Kill-cam replays, simpler menus, bigger-text and colour-blind settings, and a Potato graphics setting for old machines.

updates.title: Alpha
notes: An abandoned fairground with a ghost train, a hall of mirrors and the clown.
Spliced sentences: it cuts your words up and makes you say things you never said.
A closed subway station, the Mother, and four new classes: Sound guy, Priest, Scout and Mechanic.
Quick Play shows open public rooms, and the voice that fooled you can be saved as a video.
Escort mode, map picking, a scarier-looking mimic and a sound pass for every place.

updates.title: The big expansion
notes: New places: the church, the asylum, the mall, the school, the hotel and the woods.
New creatures: the Double, the Listener, the Stalker, the Shadow and the Caller.
New modes: Night Shift, Versus, Hide and seek, and a second story, The Operator.
Tape-recorder decoys, walkie-talkies, new hiding spots and things to throw.
A tutorial, sound captions, auto graphics, an end-of-round recap, and rejoining after a drop.
Moods and twists, so no two nights are the same.

updates.title: Release
notes: A horror game that records your voice and uses it to lure you into the dark.
Up to 4 players online with proximity voice chat.
Story mode with Ellie, and an online story, The Signal, with a secret traitor.
Hunt mode (one player is the mimic), the hospital and the skinwalker.
Controller and touch support, and it can be installed as an app.

updates.title: Achievements
notes: Achievements: unlock them as you play (a 🏆 pops up), and see them all on the Game Library's new Profile page.
Daily leaderboards: see today's top 10 for the daily challenge and put your name on it.

updates.title: Daily Pit
notes: DAILY PIT: the Rubble Pit with one modifier for the whole run, the same for everyone that day, and the same bosses.
Today's best and your day streak show on the button and on the results screen.
Sync: keep your progress on all your devices (☁ SYNC on the menu).

updates.title: Install as an app
notes: RUBBLEMAKER can be installed as an app from the menu (INSTALL APP), with its own icon. It opens fullscreen and works offline once it has loaded.

updates.title: Mason's Lodge
notes: A secret co-op campaign for two golems over a room code.
Enemies chase the nearer golem, and doors closing pull your partner into the fight.
At 0 HP you go down: your partner can lift you back up before you bleed out.

updates.title: Chiselled Stone
notes: Every menu and panel is carved stone: cut corners, bevelled light and carved capitals.
A new HUD: molten health trough, a style-meter tablet and a lintel boss bar.

updates.title: Hard mode, training, speedruns
notes: Hard mode, with its own ranks and a skin for beating it.
A training level the first time you play the campaign.
A speedrun timer, golem colours and a tuning pass.
Two new duels in Act IV.

updates.title: Act IV: The Aqueduct
notes: Twelve new levels across the Sluice, the Arches and the Cistern, with their own look and music.
Water hazards: currents, sluice-gate jets and rooms that flood while you fight.
New enemies, trainers and mini-bosses, the TIDE arm, and THE GUILDMASTER at the end.

updates.title: Three acts, seven layers
notes: The campaign is regrouped into acts and layers, and your old saves move over by themselves.
Guns are dropped by new mini-bosses instead of being sold.
Elites in the codex, 17 new achievements and 4 new skins.
Fixed the camera spinning on its own with some controllers and devices.

updates.title: The Chain Flail
notes: The CHAIN FLAIL (weapon 5): whirl it, then sweep, hook, pierce or smash.
Elite IRON and EMBER enemies.
Ghost replays of your fastest clear on every level.
A tuning pass, a performance mode and save backups.

updates.title: The Story, the Codex, new sound
notes: Story cutscenes for the prologue, each act and the ending.
The Codex: a bestiary, the arsenal, lifetime stats and 32 achievements.
A sound overhaul: room reverb, 3D sound through walls and enemy voices.

updates.title: Prime rematches and P-ranks
notes: PRIME boss rematches with new gun skins to win.
P-rank for a perfect run.
New Kiln trainers, and the RUBBLE PIT arena shifts every 5 waves.

updates.title: Brick launcher and swap chains
notes: Weapon 4, the BRICK LAUNCHER, with three variants.
Swap chains: switch weapons between hits for style and extra damage.
New enemies RAM, BURROWER and MENDER, and two new duels.
Controller and touch support, and the PRACTICE ROOM (v0.9).

updates.title: Achievements
notes: Achievements: unlock them as you play (a 🏆 pops up), and see them all on the Game Library's new Profile page.
Daily leaderboards: see today's top 10 for the daily challenge and put your name on it.

updates.title: Daily night
notes: Daily night: one night a day that's the same for everyone: the same building, the same map and a twist (Blackout, Shotgun start, Swarm, Dying batteries, Fakers everywhere or Nail gun start).
Your best for the day and a day streak are kept, separate from your normal best scores.

updates.title: The Basement
notes: New map: The Basement. Boiler room, cold store, laundry and pipe tunnels, with hardly any lamps. Fix the generator to get the lights on, and stand in the steam from the vents to hide.
New boss down there: the Stoker. It slams the floor and puts your flares out.
New guns: the nail gun (fast, pins monsters in place) and the flare gun (sets them alight). Find them lying around from 2 and 3 AM.
New monsters on both maps: the crawler moves through the ceiling vents and drops on you (watch for falling dust), and the faker looks like a pickup until you get close.
Settings: volume, screen shake, sharpness, fullscreen and controllers.
Plays with a controller, and has a pause button on phones.
Hits feel heavier: monsters flash when shot, the crosshair marks hits, and kills land with a tiny freeze.
Runs smoother with lots of monsters on screen.

updates.title: Install as an app
notes: Ward Nine can be installed as an app from the menu (Install as an app), with its own icon. It opens fullscreen and works offline once it has loaded.

updates.title: Release
notes: Work the night shift on Ward Nine, a hospital ward where something is loose.
The things in the dark hunt by noise: run and shoot, and they hear you.
Play until dawn or in an endless night, on Easy, Normal or Nightmare.
Watch out for the Ward Sister.
